substance_basis: 6 lines, 100% of them are short fragments without sentence punctuation, mean line 5.8 characters (page holds 28 visible characters in total)
summary: 200 OK · 44B markdown · stealthy · no prose (menu fragments only) · this call makes 1 extra direct request to the target before the browser runs: a liveness probe (direct, 3s, no retries, no synthetic headers, no redirect hop). Your service's own log will show that one next to the browser's navigation - it is dhole dialing, not the page. · the target is loopback/private, so the browser tier navigated without dhole's invented google referer. What that browser sends of its own (UA, `sec-ch-ua*`, `sec-fetch-*`) arrived as it always does, plus every header you named · page pinned: this one stays open on that session for the next call that passes pin=true, so the challenge, the token and the half-filled form on it are the ones that next call answers. Released after 300s, when the host changes, or when the session closes. · 1 action(s) waiting for user approval (click '#challenge-btn')
next_action: a submit action is PAUSED for user approval (pending_approval in metadata.actions) - describe the submission to the user and ask for confirmation; on a yes, re-run the same actions with {"confirm": true} on that submit. Nothing irreversible was done.

metadata.title: 抄写挑战
metadata.ssrf_recheck: ssrf: fake-ip tunnel on this host (example.com -> 198.18.0.106, example.org -> 198.18.0.107); only 198.18.0.0/15 + fc00::/7 are tolerated - loopback, RFC1918, link-local and cloud metadata are still refused.

actions.error: pending_approval: submitting is an irreversible step - ask the user to confirm this submission, then re-run the same actions with confirm: true on the click/submit action itself ({"click": {"selector": "...", "confirm": true}}), not at the top level on this click. Nothing was submitted. · THIS PAGE IS PINNED (pin=true), so that sentence is only half right: the steps before this one already ran on the page you are standing on (a form still holds what they filled). Two honest ways: re-run just this submit step with confirm: true on the click/submit action itself ({"click": {"selector": "...", "confirm": true}}), not at the top level on the same pinned session, or drop pin=true to start from a fresh navigation (a fresh challenge, a blank form)
the selector matched no element (or none became actionable) before the timeout: Locator.inner_text: Timeout 10000ms exceeded.
